reason: The change is scoped to src/payments/receipt.js. It handles zero-decimal currencies through a table (WHOLE_UNIT_CURRENCIES), and other currencies still use the shared formatter. The table only lists JPY, but adding more currencies is a one-line change, so this isn't a JPY-only literal branch. The multiply-by-100 and strip-".00" approach is a bit hacky, but it works within the scope restriction.
